_meta.purpose: 组稿框架文本（不含任何事实）。事实句一律来自材料原文，框架只提供承接与指令。

keys.n: 文首注释（证据绑定说明）
keys.h: 五个标题：背景/相关工作/研究空白/贡献/参考文献
keys.bg: 背景三段的引导语（约束→现状→未解问题）
keys.rw: 相关工作改写指引（HTML 注释）

zh.t: 引言与相关工作（证据绑定草稿 v1.0.0）
zh.n: <!-- 每句末尾的 [source_id#locator] 可回到 sources_index.json 逐字复核；改写只改表达，不改数字、术语、引用编号与结论强度。本节为草稿骨架，需作者按目标期刊语体重写连接句。 -->
zh.gn: 已引文献中未见可直接引用的限制陈述：需补充文献，或把该空白改写为作者判断并在正文标注。
zh.rw: 改写指引：同组文献合并为一段，先写路线共性（问题设定+评价方式），再写差异与取舍；不要逐篇罗列摘要。
zh.rf: 按正文首次引用编号排列；缺项标 [待补]，不要自行补全作者或年份。

en.t: Introduction and Related Work (evidence-bound draft v1.0.0)
en.n: <!-- Bracketed tags give source_id#locator, verifiable against sources_index.json. Rewrite wording only: keep numbers, terms, citation numbers and claim strength. This is a scaffold; rewrite connectives for the target venue. -->
en.gn: No citable limitation statement was found in the supplied literature: add sources, or restate this gap as author judgement and mark it.
en.rw: Rewrite note: merge works of one route into one paragraph; give the shared problem setting and evaluation first, then differences and trade-offs; do not list abstracts one by one.
en.rf: Numbered by first citation; missing fields flagged [TODO]; never fill in absent authors or years.
